007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009/**
010 * Request used to update an agent team execution state.
011 *
012 * <p>The request contains the state and typed {@link ExecutionStateParams}
013 * identifying the conversation to update. The builder also exposes a
014 * convenience method for the common conversation-ID case. Every request
015 * requires an explicit conversation identifier; the SDK does not rely on a
016 * current database session conversation.</p>
017 *
018 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetTeamExecutionStateSample.html">
019 *      SetTeamExecutionStateSample source</a>
020 * @since 1.1.0
021 */
022public final class ExecutionStateRequest {
023    /** Run state to set. */
024    private final TeamExecutionState state;
025    /** Parameters identifying the target execution. */
026    private final ExecutionStateParams params;
027
028    private ExecutionStateRequest(Builder builder) {
029        this.state = builder.state;
030        this.params = builder.params != null
031                ? builder.params
032                : ExecutionStateParams.forConversationId(builder.conversationId);
033    }
034
035    /**
036     * Returns the run state to set.
037     *
038     * @return known execution state
039     */
040    public TeamExecutionState getState() {
041        return state;
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * Returns the typed execution-state parameters.
046     *
047     * @return immutable execution-state parameters
048     */
049    public ExecutionStateParams getParams() {
050        return params;
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * Returns the conversation identifier from the typed parameters.
055     *
056     * @return database-created conversation identifier
057     */
058    public String getConversationId() {
059        return params.getConversationId();
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * Serializes the parameters for {@code SET_EXECUTION_STATE}.
064     *
065     * @return JSON object containing the target conversation identifier
066     */
067    public String toParamsJson() {
068        return params.toParamsJson();
069    }
070
071    /**
072     * Creates a builder for an execution-state request.
073     *
074     * @param state known state accepted by the database operation
075     * @return mutable builder for an execution-state request
076     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when {@code state} is null or
077     *                                  {@link TeamExecutionState#UNKNOWN}
078     */
079    public static Builder builder(TeamExecutionState state) {
080        return new Builder(state);
081    }
082
083    /** Builder for {@link ExecutionStateRequest}. */
084    public static final class Builder {
085        /** Run state to set. */
086        private final TeamExecutionState state;
087        /** Optional convenience conversation identifier. */
088        private String conversationId;
089        /** Optional typed execution-state parameters. */
090        private ExecutionStateParams params;
091
092        private Builder(TeamExecutionState state) {
093            if (state == null || state == TeamExecutionState.UNKNOWN) {
094                throw new IllegalArgumentException("state must be a known execution state");
095            }
096            this.state = state;
097        }
098
099        /**
100         * Sets the conversation identifier for the execution to update.
101         *
102         * @param conversationId database-created conversation identifier
103         * @return this builder
104         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the identifier is null or blank
105         * @throws IllegalStateException when typed parameters were already supplied
106         */
107        public Builder conversationId(String conversationId) {
108            if (conversationId == null || conversationId.isBlank()) {
109                throw new IllegalArgumentException("conversationId must not be null or blank");
110            }
111            requireNoTypedParameters("conversationId");
112            this.conversationId = conversationId;
113            return this;
114        }
115
116        /**
117         * Sets typed parameters for the execution to update.
118         *
119         * @param params typed parameters containing a conversation identifier
120         * @return this builder
121         */
122        public Builder params(ExecutionStateParams params) {
123            if (params == null) {
124                throw new IllegalArgumentException("params must not be null");
125            }
126            requireNoTypedParameters("params");
127            this.params = params;
128            return this;
129        }
130
131        /**
132         * Builds an immutable execution-state request.
133         *
134         * @return immutable execution-state request
135         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when no conversation identifier or
136         *                                  typed parameters were supplied
137         */
138        public ExecutionStateRequest build() {
139            if (params == null && conversationId == null) {
140                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
141                        "conversationId or params must be provided");
142            }
143            return new ExecutionStateRequest(this);
144        }
145
146        private void requireNoTypedParameters(String parameterName) {
147            if (params != null || conversationId != null) {
148                throw new IllegalStateException(
149                        parameterName + " cannot be combined with another parameter form");
150            }
151        }
152    }
153}
